name: Islamic Banking
short_description: Shariah-compliant banking free of Riba (interest), adhering to Islamic jurisprudence and AAOIFI standards.

name: Conventional Banking
short_description: Mainstream interest-based banking institutions providing commercial, retail, and corporate treasury operations across Pakistan.
key_features: Conventional credit card and loan products

name: Online Banking
short_description: Robust 24/7 web-based portals for bill payments, RTGS, funds transfers, e-statements, and account administration.
key_features: Utility bills, fee payments, and tax collections (1Link / 1Bill)

name: Digital Banking
short_description: Next-generation branchless banking apps, instant biometric digital onboarding, Raast P2P/P2M, and virtual debit cards.
key_features: State Bank Raast instant payment integration
Digital account opening with NADRA biometric verification
Virtual debit cards and mobile wallet integration

name: Home Financing
short_description: Housing finance solutions including Islamic Diminishing Musharakah and conventional home mortgage facilities.
key_features: Purchase, construction, renovation, and plot + build options

name: Auto Financing
short_description: Vehicle financing choices including Islamic Car Ijarah (rental) and conventional auto loans for new and used cars.
key_features: Financing for local, imported, new, and used vehicles
Competitive profit rates and reducing markups
Comprehensive Islamic Takaful or conventional car insurance
Flexible repayment tenures up to 5 or 7 years (per SBP PRs)

name: Personal Financing
short_description: Consumer loans and Islamic personal financing (Tawarruq/Murabaha) for personal emergencies, education, or wedding expenses.
key_features: Collateral-free financing for salaried & self-employed individuals

name: Business Financing
short_description: Working capital, SME credit lines, letter of credit (LC), bank guarantees, and export refinance schemes.
key_features: Working capital and term financing facilities
State Bank subsidized SME and export refinance schemes
Letters of credit (LC) and bank performance guarantees
Corporate treasury and cash management solutions
